propositions: Review gates must derive selection from one immutable effective-policy snapshot rather than partially independent discovery paths

The shared discovery executor must emit typed outcomes (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) and enforce budget, cancellation, and checkpoint mechanics without choosing applicability or truncating inputs
Project code-review LLM criteria require non-empty repository-relative globs; empty-list migration to ["**"] must audit all config references and documentation
Plan-review budget omission preserves existing per-review cap behavior; code-review omission remains uncapped; zero is invalid on both gates
rebar review-plan --retry must reuse content-identical successes, retry only missing calls with fresh budget, and refuse stale lineages before any model call
The workflow editor must separate editable Authored Workflow from read-only Effective Policy and show the digest-complete versioned discovery trace
